source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The colored bar on the top edge supplies one vertical track per color.
    for c, color in enumerate(grid[0]):
        if color == 0:
            continue
        targets = [(r, j) for r in range(1, h) for j in range(w) if grid[r][j] == color]
        if targets:
            r, j = targets[0]
            for rr in range(r + 1):
                out[rr][c] = color
            for cc in range(min(c, j), max(c, j) + 1):
                out[r][cc] = color
        else:
            for rr in range(h):
                out[rr][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'), globals())
